AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Recommendation: Review and Approve.

Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept all donation(s as presented, or remove from Consent Agenda for further discussion.

4.
Resolution R15-40; Affirming Planning Commission Approval of NC01528-G-1551/M-1057-15; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading and Miscellaneous Applications for the New Single Family Residence at 521 & 525 Via Almar, with Additional Modifications
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R15-40, affirming the Planning Commission approval of NC-1528/G-1551/M-1057-15; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading and Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence at 521 & 525 Via Almar, with modifications.
Staff Report
5.
Adoption of Ordinance 15-714; Amending the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code Title 17 (Zoning Procedures) and Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) as they Pertain to Second Dwelling Units, Accessory Structures, Definitions, Neighborhood Compatibility, Miscellaneous Permits, Mechanical Equipment Noise, Front Yard, Rear Yard, and Walls and Fences
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt on second reading Ordinance 15-714, amending the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code Title 17 (Zoning Procedures) and Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) as they Pertain to Second Dwelling Units, Accessory Structures, Definitions, Neighborhood Compatibility, Miscellaneous Permits, Mechanical Equipment Noise, Front Yard, Rear Yard, and Walls and Fences.
Staff Report
6.
Resolution R15-44 Adjusting FY15-16 Budget for Purchase of Apple iPad Tablets and Adoption of Tablet Loan/Use Policy
Recommendation: It is recommended that City Council adopt Budget Resolution R15-44 adjusting the FY15-16 to appropriate funds for the purchase of twelve (12) 32GB Apple iPad Pro tablets and accessories, and adopt the associated Tablet Loan/Use Policy.
Staff Report
7.
Legal Services Agreement with Greines, Martin, Stein & Richland LLP for Legal Services (Appellate Counsel) in Connection with CEPC v. City of PVE, et al
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Attorney to execute the retainer letter with Kent Richland and Greines, Martin, Stein & Richland LLP and approve budget appropriation Resolution R15-45.
Staff Report
8.
PW-627-15; Award of Construction Contract for Citywide Drainage Improvements and Street Repair on Various Streets
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council award a construction contract for the completion of the Citywide Drainage Improvements and Street Repair on Various Streets Project in the amount of $106,000 to Hardy & Harper, Inc. along with authorization of the $10,500 contingency.
Staff Report
9.
Traffic Safety Committee (TSC) Meeting Items of November 4, 2015
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
Neighborhood Church Sidewalk Request at 415 Paseo Del Mar
TSC Recommended
Action: Construct a minimum 5-foot wide ADA curb adjacent to the sidewalk between the circular driveway entrances. The costs will be borne by the Neighborhood Community Church. (5-0 in favor)
b.
Torrance Boundary Trail Unauthorized Vehicle Restrictions
TSC Recommended
Action: Make no changes to the existing conditions, monitor the Torrance Boundary Trail for 6 months then revisit the item. (5-0 in favor)
c.
Granvia Altamira and Via Rafael Intersection Pedestrian Accommodations
TSC Recommended
Action: Clear the landscaping on the four corners of the Granvia Altamira and Via Rafael intersection to provide an off-street pedestrian area at the intersection and to install an unpaved walkway between the existing sidewalk terminus at the City boundary on the south side of Via Rafael and the intersection of Granvia Altamira and Via Rafael. (5-0 in favor)
d.
Granvia Altamira and Via Cerritos Intersection Corner Modification
Traffic Safety Committee Recommended
Action: Modify the corner radius in the Southwest Corner of the intersection, remove the existing 15-foot radius curb to return and replace with curbing having an approximate 35-foot radius. (5-0 in favor)
e.
Palos Verdes Drive West and Via Carrillo Pedestrian Crosswalk Lighting
Traffic Safety Committee Recommended
Action: Remove the existing disabled In Roadway Warning Lights and install new Rectangular Rapid Flash Beacon lights on the existing poles with new push buttons. (5-0 in favor)
Staff Report

Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
PC-398-15; Application to retain trees, shrubs, and non-standard encroachments in the Parklands adjacent to 990 Paseo La Cresta
Applicant: Jason Moskowitz
990 Paseo La Cresta
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Parklands Committee Recommended
Action: Deny the application and require all trees, shrubs, groundcovers and non-standard encroachments removed and the Parklands be restored to a natural condition including grading as necessary. Removal of the wall shall be deferred 60 days from the City Council decision to allow for review for geotechnical impacts to determine if the wall should remain or be removed and to allow for submission of a restoration plan that includes an application for native plantings. (5-0 in favor)

2400 Via Sobrante
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Approve with modification. The Japanese Black Pines were removed from consideration and requires a new application for future review. The Italian Stone Pine is approved to be trimmed for view restoration. (4-1 in favor, Wade dissenting)

3901 Palos Verdes Drive North
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

537 Via Media

Applicant: Judy Matsuda
3721 Via Palomino
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Parklands Committee Recommended
Action: Approve the removal of 1 Casurina tree with the stump adjacent to 3721 Via Palomino according to the â€˜Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvalsâ€™. A payment of $500 to the â€˜Tree Bankâ€™ is required. (5-0 in favor)
f.
PC-412-15; Application to remove 1 Eucalyptus tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1905/09 Via Estudillo
Applicant: David Funk
1232 Via Coronel
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Parklands Committee Recommended
Action: Approve with modification to allow annual trimming to improve the view with a no-fee permit and a qualified contractor at the Urban Foresterâ€™s direction. (5-0 in favor)
g.
PC-CTP-03-15; Application to beautify a portion of Parklands located adjacent to the Via Ramon and Via Pinale triangle
Applicant: Malaga Cove Homeowners Association/Tricia Rapaport
584 Via Almar
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Approve the concept plan. (5-0 in favor)

Applicant: Frank Ponce
68 Malaga Cove Plaza
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Approve the Minor Planting Plan subject to the condition that the wildflower seed mix be native only. (5-0 in favor)
Staff Report
11.
Planning Commission Actions of November 18 and 19, 2015
Recommendation: Receive and File.
a.
M-1060-15; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for an accessory structure exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 2609 Via Segunda. Lot 6, Block 1715, Tract 6885. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Julie Waldron
6043 Scotmist Dr.
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275
Owner: Thomas & Kimberly Schloemer
Action: Approve the application with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) The structure shall be moved to comply with the required side yard building setback. (5-0 in favor)
b.
WT-125-15; Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Application for new equipment within the City right-of-way on the corner of Cataluna Place and Granvia Altamira.
Applicant: Crown Castle NG West LLC
300 Spectrum Center Dr., #1200
Irvine, CA 92618
Action: Approve the application with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The steel pole shall be burnished prior to painting. The pole and antennas must be painted a flat dark brown, and maintained in the same condition thereafter; 2) All cables interconnecting the antennas and all transmission equipment should run within the replacement pole. No interconnecting cables should run adjacent to the replacement pole except as minimally required to connect to the antennas; 3) The replacement steel pole is not a wireless tower for any purpose, but rather it is considered only a replacement City street sign pole; 4) The steel pole shall be designated as a replacement for the existing pole to be removed, and after installation, the replacement pole shall be dedicated to the City for a fee of $1.00 so that it is clear for federal law purposes that replacement pole maintain its primary use and function as a City traffic sign support; 5) The equipment cabinet should be painted a color selected by the City to blend in with the existing surrounding environment and nearby meter cabinet in the public right-of-way; 6) Permittee shall install and at all times maintain in good condition an â€œRF Noticeâ€ and â€œNetwork Operations Center Informationâ€ sign on the steel pole at approximately 14 feet AGL; 7) Permittee shall ensure that all RF signage complies with FCC OET Bulletin 65 or ANSI C95.2 for color, symbol, and content conventions; 8) Attached speed limit sign shall be installed in accordance with the MUTCD (Manual Uniform Traffic Control Devices) California Edition; 9) Attached speed limit sign shall be with approved hardware per the Cityâ€™s Maintenance Foreman; 10) A multi-purpose cabinet shall be installed in lieu of an underground vault and air vents; 11) The multi-purpose cabinet shall be relocated to be placed in the proximity of the mocked up vent closest to the location of the proposed replacement pole at the discretion of staff; 12) Appropriate landscaping shall be installed to screen the multi-purpose cabinet; and 13) The applicant shall work with City staff to provide appropriate landscape screening in the general area. (4-1 in favor, Welch dissenting)
c.
WT-126-15; Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Application for new equipment within the City right-of-way adjacent to 2800 Via Campesina.
Applicant: Crown Castle NG West LLC
300 Spectrum Center Dr., #1200
Irvine, CA 92618
Action: Approve the application with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The steel pole shall be burnished prior to painting. The pole and antennas must be painted a flat dark brown, and maintained in the same condition thereafter; 2) The CISH equipment cabinet should be painted dark green to blend in with the existing surrounding environment and nearby meter cabinets in the public right-of-way; 3) Permittee shall install and at all times maintain in good condition an â€œRF Noticeâ€ and â€œNetwork Operations Center Informationâ€ sign on the steel pole at approximately 14 feet AGL; 4) Permittee shall ensure that all RF signage complies with FCC OET Bulletin 65 or ANSI C95.2 for color, symbol, and content conventions; and 5) The steel pole shall be designated as a City owned pole after installation, and the pole shall be dedicated to the City for a fee of $1.00 so that it is clear for federal law purposes that it have its primary use and function as a City sign support. (5-0 in favor)
d.
WT-128-15; Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Application for new equipment within the City right-of-way in the center median at Via Boronada and Palos Verdes Drive West.
Applicant: Crown Castle NG West LLC
300 Spectrum Center Dr., #1200
Irvine, CA 92618
Action: Approve the application with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) The replacement pole shall be revised to a maximum height of 14 ft. (5-0 in favor)

M-1063-15; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for an accessory structure exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 1024 Granvia Altamira. Lot 2 & a portion of Lot C, Block 1750, Tract 8652. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Ron Moravek
Action: Approve the application with standard conditions. (5-0 in favor)
f.
M-1068-15; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for accessory structures exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 2124 Via Estudillo. Lot 9, Block 2300, Tract 7537. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Roy M. Glantz
Action: Approve the application with standard conditions. (5-0 in favor)
g.
CUP-89-15; Consideration of a Conditional Use Permit Application for a new restaurant within an existing tenant space at 36 Malaga Cove Plaza. Lot 11, Block 1617, Tract 6885. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Robert Bell
2820 Via Pacheco
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Owner: Joseph & Rita Barnett
P.O.
Box 193
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Approve the application with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Employees shall park off-site and shall not park within the parking lot in front of Malaga Cove Plaza commercial businesses; 2) The stairs adjacent to the tenant space shall be painted and maintained in good condition; 3) The planter area adjacent to the tenant space shall be repaired and maintained in good condition; and 4) This project shall be subject to annual review by the City.
(5-0 in favor)
h.
WT-132-15; Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Application for new equipment on an existing utility pole within the City right-of-way at 2702 Palos Verdes Drive North.
Applicant: CES for AT&T Mobility
10640 Sepulveda Blvd., #1
Mission Hills, CA 91345
Action: Approve the application with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Permittee shall place its name, contact telephone number, and site identification number on the outside of the DAS node cover; 2) Permittee shall install and at all times maintain in good condition an â€œRF Noticeâ€ and â€œNetwork Operations Center Informationâ€ sign on the wood pole at approximately 12 feet AGL ; 3) Permittee shall ensure that all RF signage complies with FCC OET Bulletin 65 or ANSI C95.2 for color, symbol, and content conventions; 4) The power meter pedestal shall be moved further down the hill towards lower Palos Verdes Drive North; and 5) Appropriate ground cover and vegetation shall be provided to screen the power meter pedestal. (5-0 in favor)
i.
NC-1542-15; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for an addition and remodeling to the single family residence located at 3301 Via La Selva. Lot 1 & a portion of Lot 2, Block 6100, Tract 6883. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Jeff & Michelle Aleixo
Action: Approve the application with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) The existing wood fence that encroaches into the City right-of-way along Via Colusa shall be removed. (5-0 in favor)
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
PUBLIC HEARING
12.
Resolution R15-47, Adopting Proposed Fees of Planning and Public Works Departments, and Office of the City Clerk
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing and adopt Resolution R15-47 adopting fees of the Planning, Public Works Departments and Office of the City Clerk effective sixty (60) days from date of adoption.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
13.
Palos Verdes Golf Club - 2015 Projected Fiscal Results and 2016 Proposed Operating and Capital Budgets and Proposed Fee Increases
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Palos Verdes Golf Club 2016 Operating and Capital Budgets and approve the proposed fee increases.
Staff Report

City Treasurer Quarterly Investment Report – September 2015
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
15.
Presentation of Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) for the Period Ending June 30, 2015
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the period ending June 30, 2015.
Staff Report - CAFR
16.
Palos Verdes Beach and Athletic Foundation Request to Exercise Option to Extend Concession Agreement for Operation and Maintenance of Roessler Pool and Associated Buildings
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council determine how to proceed in response to the PVBACâ€™s request to extend the concession agreement.
Staff Report
17.
Consideration of Pursuing Ballot Measure for Special Tax to Continue Funding Fire & Paramedic Services in November 2016 or March 2017
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council consider whether to pursue the ballot measure in November 2016 or March 2017. Accordingly, staff will proceed with the associated planning and preparation and as such, forward the necessary Resolution(s) at the appropriate time for including the special parcel tax renewal ballot measure.
Staff Report
18.
Consideration and Approval of an Agreement with FM3 and Conducting a Community-Wide Priorities and Satisfaction Survey
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R15-46 adjusting the FY15-16 budget to appropriate the funds for a survey, authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement to retain FM3 and appoint an Ad Hoc Committee to develop questions, and proceed with the surveying process concurrent with preparation of the Cityâ€™s next budget.
Staff Report
19.
Topics of Joint Meeting with City Council, Planning Commission and Palos Verdes Homes Association on January 6, 2016
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss the potential topics and provide direction to staff on which topics to proceed with for discussion at the Joint Meeting scheduled for January 6, 2016 at 7:30 p.m. in the Margate Room at Palos Verdes Golf Club.
Staff Report
20.
Adoption of Social Media Use Policy and Standards, and Update on Cityâ€™s Website Upgrades
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Social Media Use Policy and Standards for Facebook, Twitter and YouTube.
Staff Report
